title: Project Manager
summary: Keep our remote engineering interns organised, on schedule and talking clearly with the UK.
about: You are the day-to-day link between the founder in the UK and our team of engineering interns. You turn written scopes into plans, keep everyone unblocked and make sure clients get honest, regular updates. You do not write production code.
work: Break each project scope into weekly plans, tasks and milestones
Run a short daily stand-up and a weekly demo with the UK
Track progress, risks and blockers, and raise them early
Write clear weekly status reports that the founder can share with clients
Match interns to tasks and help new starters settle in
Keep the project board, meeting notes and handover documents up to date
requirements: A degree in any subject; a business, IT or engineering degree is a plus
At least two years coordinating software, IT or similar project delivery
Good fluency in written and spoken English, as most communication is in English
Confident using a task board such as Jira, Trello or Linear
A working understanding of agile ways of working (sprints, stand-ups, retrospectives)
Reliable, organised and calm when plans change
Able to give feedback kindly and clearly, and to say when something is at risk
nice: A project management qualification such as PRINCE2, PMP or a Scrum certificate
Experience supervising students or junior staff
Basic understanding of cloud, DevOps or web development
trial: A paid task: turn a short sample scope into a two-week plan with risks and a status report.

title: DevOps and Platform Engineer Intern
summary: Learn to build cloud, Kubernetes and automation for real client infrastructure projects.
about: Work alongside an experienced technical lead and the founder to build the infrastructure that other software runs on. You will start with small, well-defined tasks and take on more as you grow. Everything you build is reviewed before it reaches a client.
work: Write Terraform and Ansible to set up cloud and Linux servers
Help build and harden Kubernetes clusters
Create CI/CD pipelines that test and deploy software automatically
Set up monitoring with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
Document every build in a runbook that clients can follow themselves
Take part in weekly demos and explain what you built
requirements: Minimum: a completed bachelor's degree (or final-year student finishing within six months) in computer science, IT, engineering or a related field
Good fluency in written and spoken English
Working knowledge of Linux on the command line
Basic scripting in Bash or Python
Understanding of Git and version control
Basic knowledge of networking: IP addresses, DNS, firewalls, SSH
Careful habits with passwords, keys and changes to live systems
Willing to explore new, fun challenges and to learn by building, breaking and fixing things
Curious, patient and honest about what you do not yet know
nice: A home lab, virtual machines or personal projects you can show us
Experience with Docker, Terraform, Ansible, Azure or AWS
Progress towards a certification such as Azure Fundamentals, CKA or Terraform Associate
trial: A paid task: deploy a small app to Kubernetes from a Git repository, with an automatic pipeline.

title: AI and Machine Learning Engineer Intern
summary: Help deploy private, self-hosted AI systems that run on a client's own servers.
about: We help organisations use AI on their own data without sending it to third parties. As an intern you will help set up, test and measure open-weight language models and document search tools, with guidance from senior colleagues.
work: Run and test open-weight language models on local and GPU servers
Build document search tools that answer questions using a client's own files
Prepare and clean data for search and evaluation
Measure answer quality and write up what works and what does not
Package models and tools in containers so they are easy to deploy
Help prototype AI agents where a human approves every action
requirements: Minimum: a completed bachelor's degree (or final-year student finishing within six months) in computer science, data science, AI, mathematics, engineering or a related field
Good fluency in written and spoken English
Solid Python, including working with libraries such as NumPy or pandas
Understanding of the basics of machine learning and how large language models work
Comfortable using Linux and the command line
Understanding of Git and version control
A habit of testing claims and checking results before reporting them
Willing to explore new, fun challenges, including problems nobody has solved before
Respect for data privacy and confidentiality
nice: Experience with tools such as Ollama, vLLM, LangChain or vector databases
A thesis, project or portfolio involving machine learning
trial: A paid task: run a local model with a simple question-and-answer interface over a handful of PDF files.

title: Full-Stack Engineer Intern
summary: Build web and mobile products for our own studio products and for client projects.
about: Help build the apps, websites and APIs that make up our product and client work. You will pair with experienced engineers, write real features and see them shipped, with code review on everything you submit.
work: Build features across a React or Next.js front end and a Node.js or Python back end
Design databases and write clear, tested APIs
Build responsive web pages and, where needed, mobile screens
Write automated tests alongside your code
Review other people's code and learn from reviews of yours
Take part in weekly demos and written updates
requirements: Minimum: a completed bachelor's degree (or final-year student finishing within six months) in computer science, software engineering, IT or a related field
Good fluency in written and spoken English
Solid grounding in JavaScript or TypeScript, plus HTML and CSS
Experience building at least one full project with a framework such as React, Node.js, Django or Flask
Knowledge of SQL and relational databases
Understanding of Git, pull requests and basic testing
Willing to explore new, fun challenges and pick up unfamiliar tools quickly
Clear written communication and a willingness to ask questions
nice: Mobile experience with Flutter or React Native
Experience deploying an app to the cloud
A public portfolio or GitHub profile with projects you are proud of
trial: A paid task: build a small app with login and a simple API in a few days.

title: QA and Test Automation Engineer Intern
summary: Check our products and client deliveries before anyone else sees them.
about: Quality is how we earn trust. You will test what the team builds, automate the checks that matter and report problems so clearly that they are easy to fix. It is a strong starting role if you like finding things that others miss.
work: Write and run test cases for web, mobile and API features
Automate repeated checks with tools such as Playwright, Selenium or Postman
Test infrastructure changes in a staging environment
Log defects with clear steps to reproduce them
Check fixes and run a release checklist before delivery
Keep a simple, current test plan for each project
requirements: Minimum: a completed bachelor's degree (or final-year student finishing within six months) in computer science, IT, engineering or a related field
Good fluency in written and spoken English, since clear bug reports matter
Basic programming in Python or JavaScript
Understanding of how websites and APIs work
Strong attention to detail and a patient, methodical approach
Understanding of Git
Willing to explore new, fun challenges, including breaking things on purpose
Honest and constructive when reporting problems
nice: Experience with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or Postman
Knowledge of software testing concepts (ISTQB or similar)
Basic knowledge of performance or security testing
trial: A paid task: test a sample website, report defects clearly and automate three checks.

title: UI and UX Designer Intern
summary: Design clear, accessible interfaces for mobile and web products.
about: Design the screens and flows people actually use. You will work with engineers and the founder from sketch to finished interface, and see your designs built and shipped.
work: Turn short briefs into wireframes, flows and polished screens in Figma
Design mobile and web interfaces that are clear and accessible
Build and maintain small design systems of colours, type and components
Prepare designs and notes that developers can build from
Review the finished build against the design
Test designs with simple user feedback and improve them
requirements: Minimum: a completed bachelor's degree (or final-year student finishing within six months) in design, HCI, computer science, media or a related field, or an equivalent portfolio
Good fluency in written and spoken English
A portfolio of at least two projects; student and personal work counts
Skill in Figma or a similar design tool
Understanding of layout, typography, colour and accessibility basics
Able to explain your design choices clearly
Willing to explore new, fun challenges and take feedback well
Interest in how products are built and how real people use them
nice: Experience with prototyping or user testing
trial: A paid task: redesign one screen from a short brief and explain your choices.
